title: AI Sales Assistant for mid-market B2B companies
raw_content:
AI Sales Assistant for mid-market B2B companies (200-1000 employees)

Target User Scenario:
- User: VP of Sales or Sales Manager at mid-market B2B SaaS companies
- Scenario: Quarterly planning cycle, looking to improve team productivity without enterprise tool complexity

Why Now:
- Search volume for 'AI sales assistant' grew 150% YoY
- Enterprise solutions exist ($5k+/month) but too expensive for mid-market
- Industry-specific AI sales tools are virtually non-existent
- AI technology is commoditized and affordable

Differentiation Hypothesis:
- Mid-market focus: Features and pricing for 200-1000 employee companies
- Industry verticalization: First mover in healthcare/education/legal vertical AI sales tools
- Fast setup: Deploy in 2 weeks, not 3-6 months
